ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 30% high-intensity (white) and 70% low-intensity (black) pixel regions across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity white patches are located at the distal ends of both lobes. The left lobe contains a large white triangular patch with internal black mottling starting from the tip and tapering toward the center. The right lobe features a white patch at the distal tip. The central area surrounding the notch is characterized by solid low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central notch with a measured internal angle of approximately 25-30 degrees; the apex is sharply defined above the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude peaks and valleys; serration frequency is higher on the medial portion of the lobes compared to the distal tips; peak-to-valley depth varies between 3-10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular high-intensity white pixel groups (barnacles) along the leading edges and distal tips; scattered circular low-contrast scars are visible on the dark medial pigmentation of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical linear pixel disruptions are visible within the white patch of the left lobe; distinct parallel horizontal rake marks are visible on the lower-right dark region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle encrustation along the entire leading edge boundary; multiple circular depigmented scars (diameter approx. 5-12 pixels) consistent with parasitic attachment points distributed across the dark surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: The leading edge contour is significantly modified by biological growth (barnacle clusters), creating a secondary jagged geometric profile distinct from the fluke's structural edge.
